structure.layout: full-viewport app: fixed teal top bar with title, room identifier and icon call controls; large white video stage on left (~1080px); fixed-width 360px teal chat side panel on right with scrolling message list and composer pinned at bottom

aesthetics.typography: System stack (-apple-system / Helvetica-like) throughout: 16px nav title and identifier, 32px 'CHAT' heading, 12px message text, 10px sender/timestamp meta, 13px italic placeholder
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat hierarchy: one 32px panel heading, 16px bar text, 12px body, 10px meta; all regular weight

notes: Bootstrap-flavoured demo app (bg-info #17a2b8, btn-dark #343a40). Messages are uniform left-aligned wheat (#f5deb3) boxes with 6px radius regardless of sender—no own/other alignment, no avatars; meta line shows 'Name (__numeric id__) - 17th November, 2026 10:34 pm'. URLs in messages are plain blue links with no previews. Stage is empty white (no participant tiles rendered); a tiny self-view <video> exists bottom-left. Top-bar icon buttons are white Font Awesome glyphs without visible labels; chat icon toggles the side panel. Includes a Record control.
